camel_example: aliyun computenest ListSkills --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken 'AAAAAWns8w4MmhzeptXVRG0PUEU=' --Filter.1.Value.1 's-xxxxx' --MaxResults 20 --NeedDownloadUrl false --Filter.1.Name SkillId
kebab_example: aliyun computenest list-skills --filter '[{"Value":["s-xxxxx"],"Name":"SkillId"}]' --next-token AAAAAWns8w4MmhzeptXVRG0PUEU= --max-results 20 --need-download-url false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSkills

element_fields.help_en: The list of filter values. Valid values of N: 1 to 10
element_fields.help_zh: 过滤器值列表。N的取值范围：1~10
element_fields.name: value

element_fields.help_en:
The filter name. You can specify one or more names for the query. Valid values:

SkillId: the skill ID. Exact match.

SkillSpaceId: the SkillSpace ID. Exact match.

SkillName: the skill name.

MatchType: the match type that controls how SkillName is matched. Valid values: exact, prefix, and fuzzy.

SkillType: the skill type. Valid values: official and custom.

Keyword: keyword match for the skill name or skill description. Fuzzy match.

SkillLabels: the skill labels. Fuzzy match
element_fields.help_zh:
过滤器名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：

SkillId：Skill ID，精确匹配

SkillSpaceId： SkillSpace ID，精确匹配

SkillName：Skill 名称。

MatchType：匹配类型，控制 SkillName  的匹配类型，取值 exact(精确)/prefix(前缀)/fuzzy(模糊)

SkillType： Skill 类型，取值 official（官方）/ custom（自定义）

Keyword： 关键词匹配 Skill 名称或 Skill 描述，模糊匹配。

SkillLabels： Skill 标签， 模糊匹配
element_fields.name: name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include the download URL of the skill package
parameters.help_zh: 是否额外需要 Skill 压缩包下载链接
parameters.name: need_download_url
